result:
The night is only partly done. The drift fix and the RPM-analysis fix (WP-16) are merged into `night/2026-10-02`, and the firmware builds with 0 errors. It is **not flashed**, and nothing went into main. WP-14 (EKF shadow) is **not merged**: its worker ran out of quota partway through.

| WP | Result |
|---|---|
| WP-16, RPM time-join | Merged (d211987). I hand-checked one flight: every merged row lines up with the nearest-in-time row of the slower slot (at most 10 ms apart). Matching by row number would have agreed on only 13.7% of rows. 19 tests pass. I fixed two small things myself: a forbidden `except Exception: pass` and leftover worker notes. |
| WP-14, EKF tilt input | Partial work saved on `wp/14` (f62a874, pushed, not merged). Its own sign test was wrong, not the firmware; I fixed the test and it now passes 4/4. Still missing: the tilt gain from the replay (it is a placeholder 1.0), the tilt test, and its report. |
| Firmware build | 0 errors, 80 warnings. Copy saved as `C:/tmp/wp17/JX_FLY-night-d211987.axf`. The flash tool restores the old build files when run without `--yes`, so I called its build step directly; it doesn't touch the probe, SWD or 8081. |
| Regression tests | Drift fix 8/8, RPM median 5/5, thrust estimators 36/36. The stream tests now pass 39/39 against the new firmware file. |

**Usable k_T (thrust constant):** 9 of 13 flights give 6.72e-6 to 6.84e-6, at an assumed weight of 0.9885 kg (the drone was not weighed). Three flights give wrong values because motor channel 3's RPM reading is bad.

**For the operator:**
- Flash `night`. The first flight is the rotated takeoff: it shows whether the trim belongs to the drone or the room.
- Merging `night` into main is your call.
- WP-14 needs a second worker round after the quota resets, about 11:20.

Reports and the handoff are committed on night (58e8722) and pushed. I added a summary to `.claude_state.md` in the main repo but did not commit it.

Report: `docs/agent/reports/WP-17.md` (on branch `night/2026-10-02`). The operator's report is `docs/agent/reports/2026-10-02-morning.md`.
